text:
maria-g: AP flagged invoice INV-24-0903 with a new line called `inference_handling_fee` under Dedicated. Not in our SOW. @vendors-billing can you confirm what this is?

vendors-billing: Hi Maria, apologies. It's an itemized cross-region routing fee we began reporting in July. We should've notified customers first.

jonah: Our contract only covers reserved capacity and burst overages. Where's the contractual basis for this additional fee?

vendors-billing: It was described in the May addendum email, but we agree billing shouldn't start without explicit customer acknowledgement.

maria-g: AP put payment on hold pending clarification. Their invoice snippet: 

```
INV-2024-0903
- dedicated_reserved_commit: $12,000.00
- burst_overage (us-west): $480.00
- inference_handling_fee: $120.00
Total: $12,600.00
```

lia-accounting: Marked INV-2024-0903 ON_HOLD (vendor_dispute). AP won't pay until clarified or credited.

billing-bot: Invoice INV-2024-0903 status -> ON_HOLD by lia-accounting at 2024-09-04T14:12:00Z

sam-finance: Please share the exact usage window and rule that triggered the inference_handling_fee. We need a reproducible calc to reconcile with our meters.

vendors-billing: Our logs show a spill from 2024-08-29T03:10Z to 2024-08-29T06:20Z where ~12% of traffic was routed to eu-west fallback. The policy charges $40/hr when fallback >10% sustained qps for >1h.

jonah: That was an autoscale cold-start in us-west. Per our SLA, provider recovery events should produce SLA credits rather than a new surcharge. Committed capacity shouldn't accrue routing fees during measured incidents.

vendors-billing: Two remediation options: 1) issue a one-time credit for $120 and update the invoice, or 2) keep the line and provide per-request meter CSV for audit.

maria-g: We want option 1. Please issue the credit, update the invoice PDF, and send a short note explaining the threshold and when the fee will apply going forward for procurement records.

lia-accounting: After credit memo posts we'll clear ON_HOLD and route for payment.

vendors-billing: Credit created CM-2024-0897 for $120 and explanatory note attached. We'll update next billing cycle to clearly call out the routing fee and threshold. Apologies for the lack of notice.

sam-finance: Logged internal ticket FIN-497 to ensure this doesn't get applied retroactively to other committed accounts.

maria-g: Thanks. @lia-accounting please confirm when AP sees the credit and we'll close. :thumbsup:

lia-accounting: Tracking CM-2024-0897; will update when applied.

vendors-billing: We'll close once credit is applied on our side.
